extension.summary: Tailscale 1.104.7 for CoreELEC 21.3 ARM64 with Kodi 21.3 settings support
Tailscale 1.104.7 voor CoreELEC 21.3 ARM64 met ondersteuning voor Kodi 21.3-instellingen
extension.description: CoreELEC 21.3/AVDVPlus ARM64 only. Keeps the official addon ID, settings and tailnet state. Supports settings XML formats 1-4 and defaults to retaining CoreELEC DNS. Select this repository for updates to retain the fork fixes.
extension.news: 21.3.13.101: Updates the bundled official Tailscale ARM64 binaries to stable version 1.104.7. Retains settings XML version 4 support, optional Tailscale DNS disabled by default, persistent daemon state, and existing login and configuration.
